config.scope: AI-core area and DP-array power budgets
config.budget_rationale: Same area and same DP-array power ceiling as the baseline; one fixed deployment across precision modes.

hardware_source.policy: Immutable plotting snapshot; publish a new dated dataset for future changes. No automatic refresh.
hardware_source.ratio_definition: H:Q:E native MAC/cycle capacities divided by 16; mutually exclusive modes are not additive.
hardware_source.power_definition: Tool-reported total power, including dynamic and leakage. Original decimal strings preserved; no rounding or recomputation.
hardware_source.empty_cell_meaning: Unsupported precision; not zero and not an unmeasured supported mode.

conditions.workload: Qwen3-8B layer 0 MLP down_proj, native K per design and precision
conditions.scope: Post-synthesis zero-delay gate activity, pre-CTS and pre-route

verification.remaining_points: 6 QE expansion points preserved from the backup source
verification.limitation: Source PASS and artifact checks describe the historical measurement. Raw DC, power audit and frozen RTL paths for the two QE expansions were not found locally during the 2026-11-16 check.

implementation_notes: E256 and Q128E256 use additional combinational hierarchy expansion; costs include mapping strategy differences.
Q128E256 includes 8 input-to-S1 hold-repair buffers in the measured area.

assumptions: Fixed per-core peripheral area, calibrated from the baseline DP-area fraction.
Budget covers the modeled AI-core pool area and DP-array power; global overhead is outside this budget.
Maximum among measured mode-average DP powers, not an instantaneous electrical worst case.
Ideal full-utilization peak from DP capacity and frequency; no workload or GEMM latency model.
